note: Judged 2026-10-21 over current tags, units and records. Quote verified in RFC 5709 Section 3.3 ('Apad is the hexadecimal value 0x878FE1F3 repeated (L/4) times'), split from the Apad fill obligation of 3.3-1. The positive requires the signed trailer to equal a digest built independently with that literal Apad for every L. The negative refuses a digest made over a zero-filled trailer. Both records are on apad.
